title: Add structlog dependency and configure in Python
description: Add structlog to python/pyproject.toml [dependencies]. Configure in python/src/lichen/__init__.py or a new logging_config.py: structlog.configure() with JSONRenderer for file/CI output, ConsoleRenderer for TTY. Replace 'import logging' with 'import structlog' in the configured entry point. Verify: cd python && uv sync && python -c 'import structlog; structlog.get_logger().info("test", key="value")'
